title: /api/risk/limits reports the daily loss as an absolute amount summed over all chains next to a percentage limit, while the breaker compares each chain's loss against a per-chain ETH threshold, so the dashboard's daily-loss gauge cannot show how close the breaker is

evidence.note: totalDailyLoss = sum over enabled chains of getDailyRealizedLoss.total_loss (an absolute, negative, mixed-unit amount, AUD-DB-002)
returned as dailyLoss { used: <absolute>, limitPct: DAILY_LOSS_PCT }
the breaker: per chain, total_loss <= -(maxCapital * DAILY_LOSS_PCT / 100)
gauge percent = used / limitPct * 100 (an amount divided by a percentage)

sibling_sites_checked: All three fields of /limits (risk.ts:101-114): positionLimit (count vs count, right unit; excludes failed-held, AUD-API-001 sub_claim 5), exposureLimit (mixed-unit total, AUD-DB-002), dailyLoss (this finding). /exposure and /pnl return the mixed-unit SQL of AUD-DB-002 (linked).
severity_rationale: S3 misleading display of a safety limit; the enforcement problems (units, failed-held) are AUD-DB-002 / AUD-DB-003.
recommendation: Return per-chain used and threshold in the same unit the breaker compares (and a percentage of it), from riskManager; render per chain. Depends on card DB-01 (risk accounting basis). Phase 29 after the Phase 24 units fix.
